column1: # HTML page trees under sources/ that no other importer covers.
# name <TAB> source tree <TAB> output dir <TAB> [exclude regex]
# The CHM sets are extracted by tools/extract-chm.py (queues/chm-sets.tsv) and
# the CD/ISO media by tools/import-media.py (queues/media.tsv); these are the
# plain-HTML leftovers of the same media, so they are documented in the same
# places:
#   windows-ce-2.0  the official "Windows CE Developer" site mirror on the
#                   Windows CE 2.0 Technical Information CD (1997): the CE
#                   2.0-era white papers (w32model, porting, comm_mod, GDI
#                   overview, ...) and the product/program info pages.
#                   See sources/windows-ce-2.0/PROVENANCE.md.
#   windows-ce-4.2  the disc-level release notes / what's new of the CE .NET
#                   4.2 Emulation Edition (the two CHMs next to them are in
#                   queues/chm-sets.tsv).
#   windows-ce-5.0  the CE 5.0 CD1 release notes / what's new (the 98
#                   component CHMs next to them are in queues/chm-sets.tsv).
#   windows-ce-6.0  the CE 6.0 DVD release notes (the only CE 6.0 document on
#                   the DVD; see sources/windows-ce-6.0/PROVENANCE.md).
# The exclude field is a regex on the path inside the source tree; none of the
# trees needs one today (only .htm/.html files are looked at, and the CHMs,
# HLPs, ISOs and installers next to them are skipped by extension).
windows-ce-2.0
windows-ce-4.2
windows-ce-5.0
windows-ce-6.0
